transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1630 Seven Springs Drive?

Sí, soy yo en 1630 Seven Springs Drive.  
Estoy bien, no hay agua adentro y no necesito ayuda.
Understood, you’re at 1630 Seven Springs Drive. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Soy solo yo aquí. No hay nadie más.

I heard you're alone at home right now. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No, no hay nadie que no pueda salir solo. Todo está bien.
Understood, no one is unable to leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
No, no hay agua adentro. Estoy bien, solo estoy aquí.
If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No tengo camioneta con buena altura, ni bote, ni asientos libres en un vehículo.
Understood, no high-clearance truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 1 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Sí, eso es correcto. Solo estoy yo aquí, sin agua adentro.
Gracias por confirmar, seguimos atentos. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
